title: KAMECON
description: KAMECON is an annual anime convention held at the University of Maryland in the Stamp Student Union and is open to the public. First held in 2017, the convention made its long awaited return in Fall 2025, welcoming over 700 attendees. The event featured a live concert, artist and vendor alley, cosplay competition, gaming hall, and many other exciting activities. With KAMECON's successful comeback, plans are already underway for KAMECON 2026, stay tuned for more updates!

vendors.name: miaocherii
vendors.description: Miaocherii is a cute lifestyle, accessories, and illustration brand that strives to make people feel happy and warm, and is inspired by kawaii characters, fun trinkets, and other items that bring joy to Cherie (the owner and artist of miaocherii). Miaocherii aims to share joy through both 2D and 3D products; products range from uniquely handmade clay trinkets, magnets, and jewelry, to stationery items such as prints, stickers, memo pads, note/sketchbooks, enamel pins, and to fun cloth items such as apparel (t-shirts), blankets, tote bags and other specialty bags, lanyards, and patches. Each fall, I also create a very kawaii calendar for the upcoming year, which is very popular at events! Come check out some miaocherii goods - I hope I can bring a smile to your face with my fun cat characters and pastel colors!
